description: This file defines an interface 'StartStreamRequest' which extends 'StreamingMessage' and specifies methods related to initiating a streaming process, including retrieving the burst size and timeout duration.

classes.name: StartStreamRequest
classes.description: An interface representing a request to start a stream, including configuration details such as burst size and timeout.

methods.name: getBurst
methods.description: Returns the number of elements to send per message in the stream.

methods.name: getTimeoutMillis
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration in milliseconds for the streaming request.
